keyPoints.en: Crouch start: On your marks → Set → gun. Moving early = false start.
keyPoints.bm: Permulaan duduk: Di garisan anda → Sedia → tembakan. Bergerak awal = permulaan salah.

keyPoints.en: Relay: pass within the changeover zone; the receiver starts at the check mark.
keyPoints.bm: Lari berganti-ganti: hantar dalam zon pertukaran; penerima mula berlari di tanda semak.

keyPoints.en: Long jump: approach, take-off, flight, landing; measured to the nearest mark.
keyPoints.bm: Lompat jauh: larian landas, lonjakan, layangan, mendarat; diukur ke kesan terdekat.

keyPoints.en: Triple jump: hop, step, jump. High jump: Fosbury flop onto a thick mat.
keyPoints.bm: Lompat kijang: engkek, langkah, lompat. Lompat tinggi: gaya Fosbury ke atas tilam tebal.

keyPoints.en: Shot put is pushed from the neck; javelin overarm; discus spun and released.
keyPoints.bm: Peluru ditolak dari leher; lembing direjam dari atas bahu; cakera dilempar selepas berpusing.

keyPoints.en: Safety: throw on signal, stay out of the sector, never throw implements back.
keyPoints.bm: Keselamatan: lontar mengikut isyarat, jauhi sektor, jangan baling peralatan kembali.

tip.en: Safety rules in throwing events are never optional.
tip.bm: Peraturan keselamatan acara lontar wajib dipatuhi.
